title: Bounded coherent cohomology of a perfect complex on a Noetherian scheme
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth] (locally Noetherian and quasi-compact), and $E$ an object of $D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. If $E$ is perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex], then there exist integers $a,b$ such that $H^i(E)=0$ for $i<a$ or $i>b$, and every $H^i(E)$ is coherent [pqf-def-coherent].

proof.text: Choose the open neighbourhood U(x), strictly perfect model K(x), and derived isomorphism from [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Transport K(x) through Modules.overEquiv U(x). A finite free module has the zero-relations finite presentation. Each term retract M of a finite free N is explicitly isomorphic to the kernel of 1 - π ≫ ι on N; its inverse is kernel.ι ≫ π. Apply [lem-pqf-kernel-finite-presentation-noetherian] to obtain finite presentation of every model term. This avoids refining to affine and finite-free trivializations.

For each degree, express model cohomology as the cokernel of the lift of the incoming differential to the kernel of the outgoing differential (ShortComplex.homologyIsoCokernelLift). The kernel is finitely presented by [lem-pqf-kernel-finite-presentation-noetherian]; its quotient is finitely presented by [lem-pc-cokernel-finite-presentation-noetherian].

Compose Modules.overFunctorEquiv, overFunctor.mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso, the given derived isomorphism, DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactors, and overEquiv.functor.mapHomologicalComplexHomologyIso. This explicitly identifies restriction of global cohomology with model cohomology. Transport its finite presentation through the inverse overEquiv and glue with SheafOfModules.IsFinitePresentation.of_coversTop, the locality of the finite-presentation definition [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation]. Finite presentation implies quasi-coherence and finite type, so [pqf-lem-coherent-ft-locnoeth] yields global coherence.

A zero term has zero homology by ShortComplex.isZero_homology_of_isZero_X₂; the same comparison gives local cohomology bounds a(x), b(x). Compactness gives a finite set t of covering neighbourhoods. Put N = sup over t of |a(x)| + |b(x)|. Then -N ≤ a(x) and b(x) ≤ N for each selected x. For i outside [-N,N], every selected restriction of H^i(E) vanishes. Modules.isZero_of_iSup_eq_top, proved by section extensionality, yields global vanishing. If X is empty, t is empty and N=0, giving bounds 0,0.

lean.statement:
theorem perfect_bounded_coherent_cohomology (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hE : IsPerfect X E) :
    (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj E)) ∧
    (∀ i : ℤ, RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj E))
